title: Georgian short-term residence permit for owners of real estate worth more than USD 150,000, with their spouse and children

sources.title: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens, Article 15 – Types of residence permits, (j): a short-term permit for an owner of real estate worth over USD 150 000, the spouse and children
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens, Article 16 – The validity period of a residence permit, 1(f) and 3: extended one year at a time, up to 12 years; ends if the ownership ends
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens, Article 2 – Definition of terms, (a): alien – a person who is not a citizen of Georgia
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens, Article 14 – Body issuing Georgian residence permits and general conditions for issuing a residence permit, 1 to 1^4: a lawful stay
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens, Article 18 – Grounds for denying the issuance of Georgian residence permits, 1 and 4, as amended by Law No 1803 of 25 June 2026
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens, Article 2 – Definition of terms, (h): family member – a spouse, and a minor child of an alien, among others
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens, Article 70 – Georgian residence permit fees, 2(b): a service fee, set by an ordinance of the Government, for considering and deciding on a residence permit
Public Service Development Agency, residence permits: the short-term permit is decided on the 30th calendar day for GEL 300, the 20th for GEL 450 or the 10th for GEL 600
Civil Code of Georgia, Article 12 – Legal capacity, 2: a person who has attained the age of eighteen years shall be a person of the age of majority

requirements.title: Funds for a Georgian property, not agricultural land, whose market value exceeds USD 150,000 (in GEL)
Not a citizen of Georgia: residence permits are issued to aliens, and an alien is a person who is not a citizen of Georgia

assessments.title: Ownership of the property registered under Georgian law, its market value set by a certified assessor of an accredited body; the permit ends if the ownership ends
In Georgia on a lawful ground when applying: not as an asylum seeker, on a deferred obligation to leave, on an ordinary C visa or under Article 10(3^1)
May be refused: sufficient grounds to assume the residence is inadvisable for state security or public safety, or an activity that threatens them
May be refused: a crime against peace and humanity; wanted for an offence; a final conviction in Georgia for a less serious offence unless expunged, or for a serious one; a pending prosecution
May be refused: an infectious or other disease on the Health Ministry's list whose nature, severity or duration may threaten the population of Georgia
May be refused: forged or invalid documents submitted, incorrect data in the application or significant information concealed
No permit for an alien whose expulsion from Georgia is under review or has been decided, even while the decision is under appeal

dependents.title: Children under 18; Article 15(j) names the owner's child or children with no age and the law's family member is a minor child, so a child of 18 or more: possible

costs.title: Real estate in Georgia, not agricultural land, worth more than USD 150,000
Service fee for deciding the principal's permit application on the 30th calendar day: GEL 300 (GEL 450 on the 20th day, GEL 600 on the 10th)
Each family member applies for the same short-term permit, with the same service fee: GEL 300 for a decision on the 30th calendar day (GEL 450 on the 20th, GEL 600 on the 10th)

durations.title: Decision on the application on the 10th, 20th or 30th calendar day, by the service fee paid
The permit's validity is extended one year at a time while the alien owns the property, up to 12 years in all
